en.html:
Neither identity nor purpose was known.
Too much caution? Against such an enemy, it hardly seemed possible.

[text0010a]
　素性も目的も知れない敵だ。
　慎重にしてし過ぎるという事はないだろう。

en.html:
Quickly, I wanted it finished. That desire I put aside for now.
Up went my sword into a high guard.
en.text:
Quickly, I wanted it finished. That desire I put aside for now.
Up went my sword into a high guard.

ja.html:
[text0010b]
　勝負を急ぎたい気持ちはあったが、俺は一旦それを
抑え込んだ。
　太刀を上段に構える。

en.html:
In that posture I advanced. At the instant of impact, I took a deeply descending course.
Outside the enemy's reach.
en.text:

Outside the enemy's reach.

ja.html:
[text0010c]
　そのまま進み――激突の瞬間、俺は深く沈む進路を
取った。
　敵騎の攻撃範囲を脱する。

en.html:
Not so much as a <ruby>scratch<rt>graze</rt></ruby>.
It had done nothing but bring the axe down.

Brute force. Refined technique was not involved.
Being cautious, I did not regret. But had the appearance frightened me into giving this opponent too much credit...?

Just as I reached that thought—

ja.html:
……<ruby>掠<rt>かす</rt></ruby>りもしない。
　敵は単純に、斧を打ち下ろしてきただけだった。

　その一撃も力任せで、精緻な技とは縁遠い。
　別に後悔はしていないが……少々、この恐ろしげな
見掛けの敵を警戒し過ぎたか。

　などと考えた瞬間だった。

en.html:
An attack it had been.
The direction from which we were <ruby>poked<rt>・・・・・</rt></ruby> left no doubt of whose attack.

How it had been done—that alone was missing.
The axe should have missed us cleanly...

A hidden weapon? A technique of the body?
What was it?

...Whatever it was, being cautious did not seem a mistake.

ja.html:
今のは敵の攻撃だった。
　<ruby>つつかれた<rt>・・・・・</rt></ruby>方向を思えば、それは間違いない。

　だが手段が不明だった。
　斧の一撃は完全に躱していた筈……。

　何なのか。
　隠し武器か、それとも何らかの体術か。

　……いずれにしろ、慎重な対応を選んだのは誤りで
はなかったらしい。
